limitations: The MadeOnSol alpha leaderboard is Solana/Pump.fun early-buyer intelligence, not a universal multichain ranking.

The public demo source is delayed and rate-limited; production-grade sub-minute discovery requires a dedicated API key/provider.
Unknown alpha wallets are not assumed to be independent humans merely because exclude_bots=true; insider/sybil risk remains a separate validation layer.

netAccumulation.methodology: Persistent deduplicated ledger of confirmed BUY/SELL classifications. Includes provider-confirmed trades plus high-confidence wallet-first on-chain swap classifications; raw TOKEN_FLOW remains excluded.

cexFlows.interpretation: All watched wallets are OR-batched per topic position, block ranges are chunked, and RPC providers fail over. Exchange labels remain context evidence, not proof of sale/purchase.

smartMoneyExternal.reason: WHALES Discovery scores on-chain early buyers, but no independent external smart-money labeling/consensus provider is persisted in the WHALES report yet.

enhancements.rule: TOKEN_FLOW_CONTEXT_ONLY is never promoted to BUY/SELL without trade-level evidence. Net accumulation uses confirmed classifications only. CEX labels are context signals and never proof of sale/purchase.

items.headline: CFTC proposes federal framework for crypto exchanges offering leveraged or margined spot trading
items.summary: The CFTC proposed a voluntary federal framework for crypto asset markets offering leveraged or margined spot trading, including anti-manipulation and proof-of-reserves requirements. The measure is a proposal, not a final rule.
items.whyItMatters: The proposal could materially reshape U.S. exchange oversight and market structure by offering a federal regulatory route while imposing additional compliance and customer-protection requirements.
items.actionReason: Material regulatory development, but a proposal does not independently create a Crypto Reca buy or sell signal.

items.headline: FinCEN withdraws proposed unhosted-wallet reporting rule and CVC-mixing special measure
items.summary: FinCEN withdrew proposals that would have imposed additional recordkeeping, verification and reporting requirements for certain unhosted-wallet transactions and a special measure regarding convertible virtual currency mixing.
items.whyItMatters: The withdrawals remove two prospective U.S. regulatory burdens affecting digital-asset transaction handling and market structure, while not eliminating existing AML/BSA obligations.
items.actionReason: Material positive regulatory change, but positive news never creates a Crypto Reca buy signal.

items.headline: Federal Reserve to release September 15-16 FOMC minutes
items.summary: The Federal Reserve calendar schedules the September FOMC minutes for October 7 at 2:00 p.m. ET (20:00 Madrid).
items.whyItMatters: The minutes can change expectations for the pace and timing of further U.S. rate moves, affecting yields, the dollar and crypto liquidity.
items.actionReason: The scheduled HIGH catalyst is within 24 hours; prepare for macro-driven volatility without creating or overriding a Crypto Reca trade signal.
